description: Deep scientific & academic research tool. Queries OpenAlex and arXiv for peer-reviewed papers and preprints, returning citation counts, reconstructed abstracts, authors, and direct Open-Access PDF links.

limit.description: Number of papers to return (1-15, default: 5)

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2/v1 Base64 or JSON EIP-3009 USDC payment signature to unlock the full unmasked dataset directly via MCP

query.description: Research topic or scientific query (e.g., 'autonomous AI agents', 'zero knowledge proofs')

x_api_key.description: Optional ak_live_... 30-day Prepaid API Pass key to unlock the full unmasked dataset

name: academic_search
